text: dsh-sidebar-video-player 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的右侧栏视频播放器，通过侧边栏标签和底部快捷入口打开，可在会话旁播放本地视频或 HTTP(S) 视频地址。它支持文件拖放、文件夹播放列表、播放控制与全屏，并显示播放进度、缓冲、帧率和丢帧等实时指标。对 MP4/MOV 文件还可读取容器、音视频编码、分辨率、帧数、码率等信息，并提供原始解析数据。适合希望在 DSH 对话旁查看视频及其媒体参数的用户；无需 API Key 或外部账号。

dsh-sidebar-video-player adds video playback to the DSH Web sidebar. Play local files or HTTP(S) URLs with folder playlists, controls, and fullscreen. View live playback stats, plus local MP4/MOV metadata: codecs, dimensions, frames, and bitrate. No API key or account is required.
想在 DSH 对话旁打开一个视频播放器，直接查看本地影片。
怎么快速查看 MP4 文件的编码、帧数和码率？
I want to play videos from a folder beside my DSH session and see playback stats.
dsh-sidebar-video-player 的功能「侧栏视频播放」：从文件选择器、拖放或文件夹播放列表载入视频，也可提交 HTTP(S) 地址；播放器显示在 DSH 右侧栏，可控制播放并在列表中切换影片。
dsh-sidebar-video-player 的功能「媒体信息与播放指标」：载入本地 MP4/MOV 后显示容器及音视频轨道信息；播放时更新进度、缓冲、实测帧率和丢帧计数，并可查看原始解析数据。
dsh-sidebar-video-player 使用 HTTP(S) 视频地址时会将该地址交给浏览器的视频元素播放，因此浏览器会向对应站点请求媒体；远程视频不会进行容器解析。

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · DSH Sidebar Video Player：English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

A video player that lives in the **right Sidebar** of DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`), with live
playback telemetry and a small, read-only MP4/MOV container reader.

Open it once and you can play a local video beside the conversation while reading its
resolution, exact frame count, average frame rate, per-track bitrate, codec profile/level,
buffer health and dropped frames — numbers a plain `<video>` element does not expose.

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Install：GitHub source install (works without npm):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:XIANGDEEN/dsh-sidebar-video-player
```

For the desktop profile used by the DSH desktop app:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:XIANGDEEN/dsh-sidebar-video-player
```

If the package is later published to npm, the same profile can install it by name:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sidebar-video-player
```

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Install：Restart or reload the Web UI after installing. The plugin appears as an enabled bundle
row named `dsh-sidebar-video-player`.

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Open it：- Right Sidebar → **Start** (the guide) → **Video player**.
- Or click the video icon beside Settings at the left Sidebar foot.

The player is a right-Sidebar tab. It needs an open Session, because the right column
is session-scoped; the footer icon is disabled while no Session is on screen.

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Features：- Play a local video by picker or drag-and-drop, or load an HTTP(S) video URL.
- **Folder playlist**: choose a folder and every video inside it is listed in a column to
  the right of the player. Each card shows a **first-frame thumbnail** and a duration
  badge; click an item to switch. The active item is highlighted, and the next item starts
  automatically when one ends.
- **Sorting**: order the playlist by name, duration, modified time or size, ascending or
  descending.
- **Fullscreen**: a header control and the existing transport button both toggle the player
  fullscreen; `F` does the same. Fullscreen hides the stats and playlist and keeps the
  transport controls.
- **Playlist context menu**: right-click a card for Rename, Copy file, Copy relative path,
  Delete local file and Refresh. File actions use the browser File System Access API and
  require choosing the folder through the directory picker with write access; the read-only
  folder-input fallback disables them.
- Custom transport: play/pause, seek, volume, mute, playback rate, picture-in-picture,
  fullscreen.
- Keyboard shortcuts while the player has focus: `Space` / `K`,

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · How the MP4/MOV reader works：The reader never loads a whole file into memory. It walks top-level ISO-BMFF boxes with
`Blob.slice`, reads `moov` once (capped at 64 MiB), and extracts:

- `mvhd` for the movie timescale/duration;
- each `trak` → `tkhd` (display size, rotation), `mdhd` (track timescale/duration,
  language), `hdlr` (video/audio handler), `stsd` (sample entry, codec fourcc,
  `avcC`/`hvcC`/`av1C`, `esds`), `stts` (sample count and timing) and `stsz`
  (sample bytes for the per-track bitrate).

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · How the MP4/MOV reader works：It reports average values over the track, not instantaneous bitrate. Fragmented MP4
files are detected; when sample tables are empty, the player falls back to the measured
metrics from the `<video>` element.

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Compatibility：- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0`; built and tested against the Web client.
- Requires a browser that can decode the chosen container/codec. MP4/H.264/AAC is the
  safest choice; HEVC/AV1 support depends on the browser.
- The player is a view surface for playback and inspection. It registers no agent tool and
  writes no Session events. File writes use the browser File System Access API only after
  you choose a folder with write permission; the plugin does not request Host file-system
  authority.
- File operations (rename/copy/delete) require a Chromium-based browser or Electron and a
  folder chosen through the directory picker. The fallback `<input webkitdirectory>` path
  is read-only, so its context-menu file actions are disabled.

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Permissions and privacy：- A selected local file is read through a browser Blob URL; it is not uploaded.
- Choosing a folder with write access lets the browser rename, copy or delete files in
  that folder when you pick a context-menu action. Nothing is written without an explicit
  action and the browser's permission prompt.
- A remote URL is fetched by the browser only for playback. The plugin does not proxy
  remote media or read remote container metadata.
- No analytics, telemetry, external service, or credentials are used.
- The only Host-side surface is the plugin bundle row; all player state stays in the
  Web page.

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Verification：The MP4 reader was checked against `ffprobe` on two real files:

| File | Resolution | Frames | Avg FPS | Video bitrate | Audio |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `boot.mp4` | 1280 × 720 | 193 | 24.000 | 2.50 Mbps | AAC LC, 32 kHz, stereo |
| `background.mp4` | 1600 × 914 | 3766 | 30.000 | 0.68 Mbps | none |

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Verification：Those values match the `ffprobe` stream metadata for the same files. The plugin also
passes module-factory, manifest/locale/patch, and registration contract checks in the
source repository.

The file-operation helpers (copy naming, rename fallback, delete wiring and directory
enumeration) are covered by tests. Actual permission prompts and filesystem writes require
a Chromium/Electron environment and are not exercised by the automated suite.

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Verification：No screenshot is declared. The player is a view surface; adding a staged screenshot that
the code does not produce would be worse than an empty card. The numeric evidence above
is reproducible from the reader.

dsh-sidebar-video-player README · Known limitations：- Deep container parsing covers `.mp4`, `.m4v` and `.mov`. Other formats are played but
  only expose what the browser reports.
- Remote video is not container-probed (cross-origin reads are not assumed).
- Encrypted sample entries (`encv`/`enca`) are not decrypted or inspected.
- The per-track bitrate is an average over the track, not a live network bitrate.
- The right Sidebar is session-scoped; there is no player without an open Session.
- File operations require Chromium/Electron and a folder chosen with write permission; the
  fallback folder input is read-only.
- Copy duplicates the file inside the same folder; it is not a system clipboard file copy.
- There is no "Reveal in Explorer" action; the browser sandbox does not expose the OS file
  manager.
- Delete and rename change the local file immediately after confirmation; there is no undo.
